reconstruction_notes.en: Original fossil-shell specimen: expanding open coil, real terminal aperture with conservative shallow interior, and four simplified pairs of outward recurved hollow shell spines with flared roots. NPS named Cooperoceras paragraph consulted for basic shell/spine form; count, local pose, palette and nominal0.17m shell+horn span are art choices. Hidden chambers and microscopic sutures simplified, no copied shell mesh, attached fruit, living animal, tentacles, foot or behavioral reconstruction.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创化石壳体标本：渐扩开放盘卷、具保守浅内腔的真实末端壳口，四组成对外弯中空壳角以宽根自然衔接。NPS具名Cooperoceras段落仅支持基本壳角结构；组数、局部姿态、配色及0.17米名义壳角总展幅为美术设定。简化隐藏气室与微缝合线，不复制壳网格、不粘接果实，不恢复活体、触手、足或行为。

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish open coiled shell with conspicuous outward-curving paired horn-like projections in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
